notes.title: Demo Page Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We're excited to announce that the [b]standalone store page and review function for the Ringash demo officially opened on July 3rd![/b][/p][p]If you've tried the demo before—or if you're just now discovering it—[b]we'd love to hear your thoughts![/b] Feel free to leave a review, share feedback, or let us know what you liked (or didn't like). Every comment helps us improve the game and build something even better.[/p][p]Thank you all for your support![/p]
